review_mode: Scheduled cloud dual-review; independent Codex desk
limitations: Confidence values are subjective evidence confidence, not return probabilities. News remains unweighted in the trading score.
The latest committed raw feed was fresh at review time and the Thursday PSX session was live under the repository calendar. EXCHANGE_HOLIDAYS is empty and SESSION_OVERRIDES is empty.
Mettis publication times below use the timestamps displayed on the article pages rather than the raw feed timezone labels.

K-Electric's regulatory outcome may still be challenged in a higher legal forum, so the current negative assessment reflects the presently notified tariff and tribunal outcome rather than assuming litigation is finished.

reviewed_stories.title: K-Electric base tariff cut upheld and notified
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Direct KEL tariff and allowed-return economics.
reviewed_stories.reason: NEPRA notified K-Electric's FY24-FY30 base tariff at Rs32.37 per unit, 19% below the original Rs39.97 determination. Dawn reports the effective return falling to about 13-14% from 22-23%, and KE itself says the outcome has a substantial adverse impact and is financially unsustainable. Further legal remedies remain possible.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Page-verified on Dawn; the linked report was published September 24, 2026 at 07:04 PKT and later updated.

reviewed_stories.title: Nishat Mills signs 20MW solar and 35MWh battery project
reviewed_stories.reason: NML signed for a 20MW solar plant and 35MWh BESS at its Bekhi and Ferozwatwan plants, with generation expected in March 2027. The project should reduce exposure to purchased peak power and improve energy reliability, but the article does not disclose capex or quantified savings.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Page-verified on Mettis Global at September 23, 2026 03:30 PM GMT+05:00.

reviewed_stories.title: Brent rebounds above $100 before easing to $102.13
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Sector link to tracked Oil & Gas Exploration producers OGDC, PPL and MARI.
reviewed_stories.reason: Brent settled Wednesday at $103.08, up 3.86%, then eased to $102.13 early Thursday. That materially reverses the prior sub-$100 crude move and restores a near-term price tailwind for upstream producers, though diplomacy and inventory news keep the signal volatile.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Page-verified Business Recorder update at September 24, 2026 08:02 PKT; the prior settlement article was published at 05:47 PKT.

reviewed_stories.title: Government cuts petrol and HSD prices again
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Sector link to Oil Marketing, including PSO.
reviewed_stories.reason: Petrol was cut by Rs1.93 per litre and HSD by Rs4.21 for September 24. The article does not report a change in OMC margin structure or quantify inventory and volume effects, so the price reset alone has no defensible directional OMC earnings signal.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Page-verified on Dawn as published September 23, 2026 at 10:55 PM PKT and later updated.
